items.quote: And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand
items.claim: A serpent was caught and transformed into a rod in someone's hand
items.action: caught it, and it became a rod

items.quote: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee
items.claim: God manifested to Moses in order that the people would believe in God's identity
items.actor: the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob
